data.content_ref: inline:The problem explicitly asks the answer to draw on published definitions. SRC_002 provides no citations and no reference to published definitions of idempotency or safety, relying entirely on informal counterexamples. Additionally, its in-claim characterization of safety—'safe (duplicates are detectable and removable)'—conflates safety (preservation of system invariants under retry) with mere detectability of duplicates. A writer whose duplicates are detectable is not automatically safe: if the replay/dedup pass is absent or buggy, invariants can still be violated despite detectability. The mechanism section partially repairs this, but the core claim's definition of safety is imprecise and not grounded in the published literature the problem demands.
